channel.title: Cortexplor - AI News & Trends
channel.description: AI news, trends and numbers from Brazil and around the world.

item.title: AMD's data center revenue nearly doubles in third quarter
item.description: AMD posted $13.38 billion in revenue for the third quarter, up 45% year over year, as data centers reached 64% of total sales, per CNBC and SiliconANGLE.

item.title: US Midterm Voters Reject AI Data Centers Nationwide in Vote
item.description: US voters approved restrictions on AI data centers in the November 3 midterms; only one local vote, in Harwood, rejected the limit, per CNBC and Engadget.

item.title: OpenAI Acquires Developer Startup Pierre Computer for Codex
item.description: OpenAI is buying developer tooling startup Pierre Computer to feed its Codex tool; the deal's terms were not disclosed, according to SiliconANGLE and Tecmundo.

item.title: ChatGPT's search traffic hits a fifth of Google's, OpenAI says
item.description: OpenAI says ChatGPT's search query volume now equals 20% of Google's, a figure announced by an executive and reported by The Verge and Olhar Digital this week.

item.title: Google shuts off Search in schools that block its AI tools
item.description: Google confirms that US schools blocking Gemini and other AI tools will also lose all access to Google Search, according to The Verge and SiliconANGLE.

item.title: OpenAI Rebrands Data Centers as 'Compute Campuses' Ahead of US Vote
item.description: OpenAI renames its data centers 'compute campuses' ahead of US midterms, amid criticism over energy costs, according to TechRadar and The Verge reports.

item.title: Musk Mocks Altman Over His 'Terrible' Home PC RAM Comment
item.description: Elon Musk mocks Sam Altman for saying home PC RAM is wasteful, as a memory pricing crisis already hits the market, according to TechRadar and Computer Hoy.

item.title: IBM updates Granite Switch without retraining the base model
item.description: IBM released Granite Switch 4.1.1, which adds new features without retraining the base model, according to the company's own announcement on Hugging Face.

item.title: Musk confirms Grok Bot usage cut over unsustainable costs
item.description: Elon Musk confirmed Grok Bot's usage limits were cut on purpose over high costs, per TechCrunch and TechRadar. Here's what changed and who it affects.

item.title: OpenAI to merge ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs starting in December
item.description: OpenAI will merge ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs into one screen in December, sharing the same token allowance with Codex, according to TechCrunch and ZDNet.

item.title: Meta funds research at five US universities with its AI models
item.description: Meta announces research partnerships with five US universities and $2 million in funding for projects using its AI models in medicine, according to the company.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 4 Carbon for cyber defense
item.description: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 4 Carbon, a model built for cybersecurity and long engineering tasks, with restricted early access and Argon's pricing.

item.title: Nvidia releases open-weight speech model for 40 languages
item.description: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weight speech model covering 40 languages that is already available on Hugging Face, the company says.

item.title: Meta expands its personal AI agent Muse to Singapore market
item.description: Meta expands its personal AI agent Muse to Singapore, adding local partners such as Shopee, Grab and Singapore Airlines, the company has now announced.

item.title: Judge Rejects xAI Bid to Dismiss NAACP Pollution Lawsuit
item.description: A federal judge denied xAI's motion to dismiss the NAACP's Clean Air Act lawsuit over unpermitted gas turbines powering its Colossus data center near Memphis.

item.title: Google's Project Suncatcher satellite goes live in orbit
item.description: Google's Project Suncatcher satellite is now online and generated its first haiku in orbit using the Gemma 4 model, according to TechCrunch and The Verge.

item.title: Mistral releases open weights for its 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
item.description: Mistral has released open weights for its Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model with coding gains, according to the company and Hugging Face.

item.title: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Speed Up Drug Development
item.description: OpenAI has acquired biotech startup Orchestra Bio, whose AI agents coordinate drug development programs, folding it into its Rosalind life sciences platform.

item.title: Hacker breaches over 100 company sites using an army of AI agents
item.description: A hacker used AI agents with little human input to breach over 100 company sites; Reuters confirms John Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins among the victims.

item.title: $2.5 Million RTX 5090 Shipment Vanishes at Brazil Airport
item.description: A shipment of RTX 5090 cards worth around $2.5 million vanished at Brazil's Guarulhos airport, distributor Oderço says, as AI demand pushes up GPU prices.

item.title: Microsoft Rolls Out Real-Time Risk Scoring for AI Agents
item.description: Microsoft is rolling out controls that score the risk of AI agents inside companies and can isolate one before it causes harm, SiliconANGLE reports today.

item.title: Apple's MLX Update Runs an 816-Billion-Parameter Model on Macs
item.description: Apple updates MLX to use RDMA over Thunderbolt, linking several Mac Studios to run an 816-billion-parameter AI model locally, the company says in a new post.

item.title: US Orders Federal Agencies to Remove DeepSeek AI From Systems
item.description: DHS orders US civilian federal agencies to strip DeepSeek AI products from their IT systems and blocks new purchases, citing the risk of data reaching China.

item.title: Anthropic says AI cut junior hiring, added meeting time
item.description: Anthropic's own workforce report shows fewer junior hires and more time spent in meetings over the past year, per coverage from TechCrunch and TechRadar.

item.title: Google expands Deep Review AI tool beyond academic papers
item.description: Google has publicly launched Deep Review, expanding its AI document-checking tool from academic peer review to everyday legal and financial paperwork.

item.title: Anthropic Commits 5% of Shares to New Public Benefit Fund
item.description: Anthropic creates a public benefit fund holding 5% of its shares, which can grow further with the company's valuation, according to Anthropic and TechCrunch.

item.title: Facebook now lets users type what they want to see in their feed
item.description: Meta updates the Facebook algorithm: users can now type, in their own words, exactly what they want to see more or less of in Feed and Reels, in real time.

item.title: Apple research finds mixing languages beats hyperparameter tuning
item.description: Apple research tests mixing a high-resource language into low-resource model pre-training and finds larger gains than hyperparameter tuning alone provides.

item.title: NVIDIA opens Vera Rubin rack architecture to data center industry
item.description: NVIDIA opens its Vera Rubin rack architecture to the Open Compute Project and publishes new open standards for AI data centers, the company announced.

item.title: AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI Race to Hire AI Deployment Engineers
item.description: AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI race to hire AI deployment engineers, as U.S. postings for the role jumped from 200 to over 7,300 in three years, CNBC reports.
